name: Crack a fetch on turn 1-2 for a shockland that unlocks a hand card, when no basic reaches it
intent: Review item 3's fallback: once open-fetch-unlocks was narrowed to unlocks_by_basic_search (never cracking a fetch for nothing when the library holds no reachable basic), a hand fetch whose own search can reach an unlock only through a non-basic land - a shockland the library holds, no basic - needed a play of its own, or that unlock would go begging entirely. Plays a fetch from hand and cracks it for whatever library land unlocks some other hand card, paying life for both the fetch's own find (when it is itself a shock) and, if the found land also enters only untapped_if_paid, that land's own life cost too - strictly the most expensive of the fetch family, so it stands down whenever anything cheaper covers the same unlock: open-land-unlocks (a free untapped land), open-shock-unlocks (a hand shockland already reaches the unlock directly, one payment instead of two), and open-fetch-unlocks (the fetch can reach a basic instead, free). Same fetch-selection prefer as open-fetch-unlocks (a fetch whose other search target is Island, esper-blink's dead colour) and the same untapped-and-can-actually-reach-it restriction on the crack source, reading the broader unlocks_by_search since this play exists precisely for the fetch that cannot reach a basic. Its own choose_cards pick still prefers a basic first as a defensive no-op (the true condition already guarantees none is reachable, so this never actually resolves to one) then a shockland, paying life. Stands down at 7 life or less and once the library is down to 5 cards or fewer. Only turns 1-2, land drop available, mine, precombat main, empty stack. Stands down once two or more untapped mana is already up: the seat-admitted orchid-phantom-breaks-tron play (eldrazi-ramp only) needs that much to cast the two-mana flier, and this land-drop decision is judged before that turn's land is played, so on a genuine turn 1-2 board this key costs nothing here - untapped mana cannot reach 2 before the first or second land drop without a mana source this deck does not run.
